issues.description: The problem statement / UML requires the Lecture constructor parameters to follow the attribute order (lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors). The solution implementation uses a different parameter order (lectureName, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents), which conflicts with the specified order and the explicit task note about constructor parameter ordering. This mismatch can confuse students about the expected constructor signature and may cause automated tests or grading scripts that expect the UML order to fail.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the constructor in src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java to follow the UML/order specified in the problem statement: public Lecture(String lectureName, int numberOfInscribedStudents, int numberOfGuestStudents, int numberOfLecturers, int numberOfTutors) and assign the fields accordingly (this.numberOfInscribedStudents = numberOfInscribedStudents; this.numberOfGuestStudents = numberOfGuestStudents; this.numberOfLecturers = numberOfLecturers; this.numberOfTutors = numberOfTutors). Ensure the template, solution, and problem statement all agree on this parameter order.
